name: steward-skills-ai-tooling
title: workstation-steward in Claude Code: is the AI tooling OK?
desc: An illustrative Claude Code session, looping, in two scenes. Asked whether the AI tooling is OK, the ai-tooling skill runs steward ai drift and explains its one finding: three launcher configs still start Node 26.4.0 by its exact path, missing later security fixes and due to break when it is pruned. It offers three choices; after the user picks the fix, it shows the repin plan, asks, applies it with a receipt, runs drift again (clean), and says how to undo it.

scenes.out: ⎿  Summary: 1 drift, 0 warning(s) across 12 project(s) (9 onboarded, 3 ignored). Nothing was changed.

segs: Mostly, yes: the AQE runtime, Ruflo, the hybrids and every guard match your policy. One thing drifted:

scenes.out: 3 launcher configs in web and api still start Node 26.4.0 by its exact path. They work today, but they
miss 26.12.1's security fixes and will break when prune removes 26.4.0. `steward ai repin` moves
them to node/26, which always follows the newest 26.x.

segs: Show the repin plan, then apply it (Recommended)

scenes.out: ⎿  Summary: 0 drift, 0 warning(s) across 12 project(s) (9 onboarded, 3 ignored). Nothing was changed.

segs: Fixed. Claude and Codex sessions that are already running keep the old paths until restarted; new

scenes.out: ones use node/26. To undo: steward ai repin --rollback <that receipt>.
